name: Chrissy Houlahan
stance: Wants Congress to stay in session to vote on AI safeguards and has demanded Defense Department answers after a false AI-generated intelligence report prompted a military response.

statements.text: The American people rightfully have deep concerns about this technology, especially in the hands of our adversaries. If we can't intervene, then the executive branch must.
AI isn’t slowing down. Neither should Congress. That is why I joined nearly 100 of my colleagues to call on Speaker Johnson to keep Congress in town and vote on AI safeguards.

We cannot let AI push the United States to the brink of war with China – or with any nation. DoD officials must provide answers to Congress now about how they let a false AI-generated intelligence report dictate an official military response for a scenario that was not happening.
Speaker Johnson is taking the nation's valid concerns about AI and instead of bringing the House back to tackle them, is trying to convince Americans that's a foreign actor is simply scaring us all.
